title: Custom MATLAB file
text: Update active configuration parameters of parent model by using file containing custom MATLAB code, {Configure the model for} sets Configuration objective; {Configuration function} sets the custom MATLAB script and {Invoke build process after configuration} sets the initiate build process. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Configure the model for
params.values: Configuration objective Custom (default) | ERT (optimized for fixed-point) | ERT (optimized for floating-point) | GRT (optimized for fixed/floating-point) | GRT (debug for fixed/floating-point)
